questions.q: Why does the beggar child look sad?
questions.explain: The beggar child has no food.

questions.q: Who are the children on the street dreaming about?
questions.explain: The children on the street dream about the food that others throw away.

questions.q: What does the narrator want the reader to learn?
questions.explain: The narrator wants the reader to learn to share the food that they don't eat.
